domains.stack.web: static HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no build step
domains.stack.mobile: an installable PWA with a Capacitor config for Android and iOS
domains.honest.mobile: Native Android and iOS builds need Android Studio or Xcode on this computer (npx cap add android, npx cap open android); the PWA installs from the browser without them.
domains.stack.desktop: a Neutralinojs app (HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a native window)
domains.honest.desktop: Running and packaging it needs the Neutralinojs binaries (npx @neutralinojs/neu update, then neu run or neu build); installers and code signing are separate steps per OS.
domains.stack.backend: a Node HTTP API (node:http, no framework) with node:test tests
domains.stack.cli: a Node CLI with util.parseArgs and node:test tests
domains.stack.extension: a Manifest V3 extension (service worker, popup, content script)
domains.honest.extension: Load it with "Load unpacked" on the extensions page in developer mode; publishing needs a developer account in the browser's store.
domains.stack.game: a canvas game (requestAnimationFrame loop, keyboard and touch input)
domains.stack.data: a Node data script (CSV in, report out) with node:test tests
domains.stack.security: a read only audit of the project (secrets, risky code, dependencies)
domains.stack.devops: container, CI and deploy files (Dockerfile, CI YAML, service units)
domains.stack.chat: an answer in the chat, no build
domains.defaults.web: plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript; light and dark theme; responsive from 375 px; system fonts
domains.defaults.mobile: Android and iOS from one codebase; works offline; light and dark theme; installable as a PWA
domains.defaults.desktop: Windows, macOS and Linux; a native window; light and dark theme following the system
domains.defaults.backend: JSON over HTTP on the PORT environment variable; node:test tests; no framework
domains.defaults.cli: Node with util.parseArgs; --help; errors on stderr with exit code 1; node:test tests
domains.defaults.extension: Manifest V3; a popup; storage.local; no remote code
domains.defaults.game: canvas 2D; pauses when the tab is hidden; best score saved in this browser
domains.defaults.data: Node script; the input file is never changed; bad rows reported with their line
domains.defaults.security: secrets, risky code and dependencies; read only; every fix waits for your approval
domains.defaults.devops: pinned versions; non root; secrets only from the environment or the CI secret store
domains.why.model: that is how the model read the request
domains.why.default: nothing points to another kind of project

domains.q.platform.text: What should {subject} be: a website, a phone app, a desktop app or an API?
domains.q.platform.web.label: Website
domains.q.platform.web.desc: Opens in any browser, nothing to install, the easiest to share.
domains.q.platform.web.reason: works on every device and needs no extra tools here
domains.q.platform.mobile.label: Mobile app
domains.q.platform.mobile.desc: Installable PWA plus a Capacitor project; native builds need Android Studio or Xcode.
domains.q.platform.desktop.label: Desktop app
domains.q.platform.desktop.desc: Its own window on Windows, macOS and Linux, can read and write local files.
domains.q.platform.desktop.reason: the request talks about a program for the computer
domains.q.platform.backend.label: Backend API
domains.q.platform.backend.desc: An HTTP API with tests for other apps to call; no screens.
domains.q.platform.backend.reason: the request talks about a server or data for other apps
domains.q.platform.cli.label: Command line tool
domains.q.platform.cli.desc: A terminal command with flags, good for scripts and automation.
domains.q.platform.cli.reason: the request talks about the terminal
domains.q.platform.game.label: Browser game
domains.q.platform.game.desc: A canvas game that runs in the browser with keyboard and touch.
domains.q.platform.extension.label: Browser extension
domains.q.platform.extension.desc: Adds a button or changes pages in the browser; installed per browser.
domains.q.platform.extension.reason: the request talks about the browser
domains.q.any.data.device.label: On this device
domains.q.any.data.device.desc: Saved locally: works offline and needs no account, but stays on one device.
domains.q.any.data.device.reason: nothing in the request needs sharing between devices
domains.q.any.data.server.label: Synced on a server
domains.q.any.data.server.desc: Every device sees the same data; a small API must keep running.
domains.q.any.data.server.reason: the data is shared between people
domains.q.any.data.none.label: Nothing saved
domains.q.any.data.none.desc: Starts fresh every time; the simplest and most private.
domains.q.any.auth.text: Do people need to sign in to {subject}?
domains.q.any.auth.none.label: No sign in
domains.q.any.auth.none.desc: Opens straight away; each device keeps its own data.
domains.q.any.auth.none.reason: nothing is shared, so an account adds steps without a gain
domains.q.any.auth.accounts.label: Accounts with passwords
domains.q.any.auth.accounts.desc: Each person sees their own data; needs a server and careful password storage.
domains.q.web.data.text: Should {subject} remember what people add between visits?
domains.q.web.data.browser.label: Saved in this browser
domains.q.web.data.browser.desc: localStorage: works offline and needs no server, but stays on one device.
domains.q.web.data.browser.reason: nothing in the request needs sharing between devices
domains.q.web.data.server.label: Saved on a server
domains.q.web.data.server.desc: A small Node API stores it, so every device sees the same data; it must keep running.
domains.q.web.data.none.label: Nothing saved
domains.q.web.data.none.desc: Starts empty on every visit; the simplest and most private.
domains.q.web.scope.text: How much should {subject} include in this first version?
domains.q.web.scope.one.label: One focused page
domains.q.web.scope.one.desc: A single page with the main sections, ready quickly and easy to change.
domains.q.web.scope.one.reason: a short request is best answered with one solid page first
domains.q.web.scope.few.label: A few pages
domains.q.web.scope.few.desc: Home plus 2 or 3 linked pages with shared navigation; takes longer.
domains.q.web.scope.app.label: An interactive app
domains.q.web.scope.app.desc: One page with real features (forms, lists, filters) written in JavaScript.
domains.q.web.scope.app.reason: the request describes actions, not only content
domains.q.mobile.data.device.label: On the phone
domains.q.mobile.data.device.desc: IndexedDB on the device: works offline, no account, but no sync between phones.
domains.q.mobile.data.device.reason: it works offline and needs nothing else running
domains.q.mobile.data.server.label: Synced through a server
domains.q.mobile.data.server.desc: Data follows the user to every phone; needs a backend API that keeps running.
domains.q.mobile.data.server.reason: the data is shared between people
domains.q.mobile.data.none.label: Nothing saved
domains.q.mobile.data.none.desc: A tool or viewer that starts fresh every time; nothing to back up.
domains.q.mobile.auth.text: Do people need to sign in to {subject}?
domains.q.mobile.auth.none.label: No sign in
domains.q.mobile.auth.none.desc: Opens straight away; each phone has its own data.
domains.q.mobile.auth.none.reason: nothing is shared, so an account adds steps without a gain
domains.q.mobile.auth.pin.label: Local PIN lock
domains.q.mobile.auth.pin.desc: A PIN on this phone hides the data from others; nothing leaves the phone.
domains.q.mobile.auth.accounts.label: Accounts on a server
domains.q.mobile.auth.accounts.desc: Email and password through your own API; needed when people share data.
domains.q.desktop.data.json.label: File in the app folder
domains.q.desktop.data.json.desc: One JSON file in the user data folder: simple, easy to back up, one user at a time.
domains.q.desktop.data.json.reason: it keeps everything on this computer with nothing to install
domains.q.desktop.data.files.label: Files the user picks
domains.q.desktop.data.files.desc: Open and save dialogs, like a document editor; the user decides where files live.
domains.q.desktop.data.sql.label: Embedded SQL file
domains.q.desktop.data.sql.desc: Handles thousands of records and searches well; one more dependency to ship.
domains.q.desktop.data.sql.reason: there will be a lot of records
domains.q.backend.data.sqlfile.label: Embedded SQL file
domains.q.backend.data.sqlfile.desc: One database file, no server to install; best for one machine.
domains.q.backend.data.sqlfile.reason: it runs on this PC without installing a database server
domains.q.backend.data.json.label: JSON file
domains.q.backend.data.json.desc: The simplest to read and edit, fine for small data with one writer.
domains.q.backend.data.memory.label: In memory
domains.q.backend.data.memory.desc: Fastest to build; everything resets when the server restarts.
domains.q.backend.data.server.label: SQL database server
domains.q.backend.data.server.desc: Scales and is shared by many servers; you install and configure it.
domains.q.backend.auth.key.label: Apps with an API key
domains.q.backend.auth.key.desc: A secret key in a header; simple and right for one client app.
domains.q.backend.auth.users.label: Signed in users
domains.q.backend.auth.users.desc: Accounts with hashed passwords and session cookies; more code and more to secure.
domains.q.backend.auth.open.label: Anyone on this network
domains.q.backend.auth.open.desc: No auth, bound to localhost; only for local tools and prototypes.
domains.q.game.controls.both.label: Keyboard and touch
domains.q.game.controls.both.desc: Arrow keys on a computer and on screen buttons on a phone; a bit more UI work.
domains.q.game.controls.both.reason: it runs in the browser on any device
domains.q.game.controls.keyboard.label: Keyboard only
domains.q.game.controls.keyboard.desc: Tight controls on a computer; not playable on phones.
domains.q.game.controls.touch.label: Touch only
domains.q.game.controls.touch.desc: Tap and swipe, made for phones; awkward with a mouse.
domains.q.game.players.solo.label: One player
domains.q.game.players.solo.desc: Score and levels against the game; the simplest to balance.
domains.q.game.players.solo.reason: one player games are quick to finish and test
domains.q.game.players.cpu.label: Player against the computer
domains.q.game.players.cpu.desc: A simple computer opponent; adds AI logic and difficulty levels.
domains.q.game.players.hotseat.label: Two on one device
domains.q.game.players.hotseat.desc: Two players share the keyboard or screen; no network needed.
domains.q.game.players.hotseat.reason: it is played with a friend
domains.q.extension.reach.active.label: Only when clicked
domains.q.extension.reach.active.desc: activeTab permission: the extension sees a page only when the user clicks it; asks nothing at install.
domains.q.extension.reach.active.reason: the fewest permissions pass store review fastest
domains.q.extension.reach.some.label: On a few named sites
domains.q.extension.reach.some.desc: Runs by itself on the sites you list; the install dialog names them.
domains.q.extension.reach.all.label: On every site
domains.q.extension.reach.all.desc: Broad permission: shows a strong warning at install and gets a stricter review.
domains.q.extension.reach.all.reason: it must act on every page
domains.q.data.input.csv.label: A CSV file
domains.q.data.input.csv.desc: One spreadsheet export; the script checks columns and reports bad rows.
domains.q.data.input.json.label: A JSON file
domains.q.data.input.json.desc: Structured data from an app or API export.
domains.q.data.input.json.reason: the data comes from an app
domains.q.data.input.folder.label: A folder of files
domains.q.data.input.folder.desc: Many files processed in one run with a summary at the end.
domains.q.data.output.table.label: Summary in the terminal
domains.q.data.output.table.desc: Totals and counts printed as a table, nothing written to disk.
domains.q.data.output.table.reason: the quickest way to see the answer
domains.q.data.output.csv.label: A new CSV file
domains.q.data.output.csv.desc: Clean or aggregated rows to open in a spreadsheet.
domains.q.data.output.csv.reason: the result goes back to a spreadsheet
domains.q.data.output.json.label: A JSON report
domains.q.data.output.json.desc: Machine readable totals for another program.
domains.q.data.output.chart.label: An SVG chart
domains.q.data.output.chart.desc: A bar or line chart as an image file, no libraries.
domains.q.data.output.chart.reason: the result is shown to people
domains.q.cli.input.args.label: Files given as arguments
domains.q.cli.input.args.desc: cli file1 file2: clear and easy to test.
domains.q.cli.input.args.reason: arguments are the most common and the easiest to document
domains.q.cli.input.stdin.label: Standard input
domains.q.cli.input.stdin.desc: Works in pipes (cat data | cli); no file names needed.
domains.q.cli.input.stdin.reason: it is part of a pipeline
domains.q.cli.input.both.label: Both
domains.q.cli.input.both.desc: Arguments when given, standard input otherwise; a little more code.
domains.q.devops.target.container.label: In a container
domains.q.devops.target.container.desc: A Dockerfile with a pinned base image and a non root user; runs the same everywhere.
domains.q.devops.target.server.label: On a Linux server
domains.q.devops.target.server.desc: A systemd service unit with restart and logs; no container runtime needed.
domains.q.devops.target.static.label: On a static host
domains.q.devops.target.static.desc: Only built files are uploaded; no server code runs.
domains.q.devops.ci.text: Should {subject} also get a CI workflow that runs the tests?
domains.q.devops.ci.yes.label: Yes, on every push
domains.q.devops.ci.yes.desc: A CI YAML with pinned actions runs the tests on each push and pull request.
domains.q.devops.ci.no.label: No CI for now
domains.q.devops.ci.no.desc: Only the deploy files; tests stay manual.
